name: StableNormal turbo
plain: StableNormal turbo from Stable-X (Ye et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2024): surface normals from one image in one step on a Stable Diffusion UNet with a ControlNet image encoder. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: StableNormal turbo (Ye et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2024): surface normals in one step (YOSO, v0.3); a Stable Diffusion 2 UNet denoises a normals latent with the image latent fed through a ControlNet encoder.

papers.title: StableNormal: Reducing Diffusion Variance for Stable and Sharp Normal

limitations: Diffusion model: the seeded noise comes from a CPU generator; upstream draws it from the unseeded global RNG, so its outputs vary from call to call (slightly).
Upstream's `Predictor` wrapper (pre-resize to a multiple of 64 near 1024 px, uint8 round trip, LANCZOS back) is not applied: the runners follow its pipeline (768 px).
A traced or exported module reuses the noise of its traced shape.
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a depth or inverse-depth map. `kind` (a card field, `result.kind`) says what the numbers mean: `metric` = metres; `scale_invariant`, `affine_invariant` and `affine_invariant_inverse` are relative (unknown scale or shift, not metres). Metric models that use the focal length take `model(image, intrinsics=K)` (K `[3, 3]`, pixels of the input): `metric3d-vit-large` and `da3metric-large` need it for correct metres (`da3metric-large`: metres = output x focal / 300; without `intrinsics=` a 300 px focal length is assumed, wrong for a real camera). `unidepth-v2-vitl14`, `unik3d-vitl`, `depth-pro` and MoGe estimate the camera themselves (given `intrinsics=` replace `fx`); `zoedepth-nk` and the relative models (`da3mono-large` too) take none. Normals-only models (`kind` `none`) return `result.normals` `[B, H, W, 3]` (unit vectors, camera frame: x right, y down, z forward).

variants.name: stablenormal-turbo

licence.training_note: Stable Diffusion 2 (LAION-5B subsets) fine-tuned on synthetic and real normals datasets (Hypersim, Replica, ScanNet and others per the StableNormal paper, arXiv 2406.16864)

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream YOSONormalsPipeline (turbo, t_start 0), diffusers 0.41.0, latents seed 0

quality.title: iBims-1 normals, mean / median angle deg, % < 11.25 / < 30 deg
quality.protocol: AbsRel / delta1 after a least-squares scale + shift fit (in disparity space for inverse-depth models), mean over images.

original32.note: upstream YOSONormalsPipeline (turbo, t_start 0), diffusers 0.41.0, latents seed 0

original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream YOSONormalsPipeline (turbo, t_start 0), diffusers 0.41.0, latents seed 0

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.00046 and p99 <= 0.0021 (absolute error of the output `normals`).
